name: deck_export
description: Export a projection to `out`: `pdf` (each slide at its last state, or `states`, a page each), `png` or `svg` (an image per state, into a directory), `mp4`, `webm`, or `prores` (the timeline, each state's cue then its hold, at `fps`; needs ffmpeg), or `spine`, which is also returned. `html` names the PLAN task that builds it. An export that takes longer than 40 s keeps going: the call returns `running`, how far it has got, and the same call again waits for the rest, then returns what it wrote.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

format.description:
`spine`, `pdf`, `png`, `svg`, `mp4`, `webm`, or `prores`; `html` names the PLAN task
that builds it.

states.description:
The states a frame export draws, in this order: an image each (png, svg), a page
each (pdf), or each one's part of the timeline (video). Without it: every state; a
PDF's slides, each at its last state, in spine order; a video's whole timeline.

out.description:
Where to write it: a file (pdf, video, spine), or a directory that gets an image per
state (png, svg). Only the spine needs none.

size.description:
`WxH` pixels for png, svg, and video, in the canvas's aspect ratio; the canvas's
size without it.

fps.description: A video's frames a second; 60 without it.

audio.description:
A video's sound track, any file ffmpeg reads, from the first frame: cut where the
video ends, or carried on in silence until it does.

SpineProjection.title: Scaena spine projection
SpineProjection.description:
The spine projection: `export --format spine` writes it; `spine_read` returns it
without timing or renders.

scaena.description: The format of the deck it was projected from: its `scaena`.

lang.description: The deck's language (BCP 47), for a voice that reads it.

canvas.description: The deck's canvas, in canvas units: width and height.

formats.description:
The formats the deck lists (SPEC §3.4), as it names them: `16:9`, `9:16`. A beat
has a render in each whose canvas is not the deck's own.

spine.description: The spine as the deck holds it; absent if it has none.

beats.description: Every beat, by id, in spine order.

Id.description: A slug: unique within its collection (SPEC §3.2).

claim.description: One sentence the audience should leave with.

SpineState.description: A state: its slide, its notes, and where it plays.

hold.description: Its dwell at rest, ms, as the deck gives it.

start.description: When its transition starts on the global timeline, ms. Given the timeline.

span.description: Its cue, ms: its transition and motions. Its hold follows. Given the timeline.

SpineBeat.description: A beat: the state that shows it, when it plays, and its renders.

state.description:
The state that shows it: the last of its states in the deck's order. None if it
names no state of the deck.

start.description:
When it starts on the global timeline, ms: where its first state starts. Given the
timeline.

end.description: When it ends, ms: where its last state's hold ends. Given the timeline.

thumbnail.description:
`state` at rest, small, in the deck's own format: a path relative to the
projection's file. Once drawn.

formats.description:
`state` at rest in each of the deck's other formats, at that format's canvas size:
paths relative to the projection's file, by format. Once drawn.

Played.description:
A state's part of a video, ms: its cue (`span`, its transition and motions), then its
`hold`, from `start`.

start.description: When it starts, ms into the video.

Chapter.description: A part of a video a player can skip to: a beat of the spine, by its claim.

beat.description: The beat it plays, if a beat names its states.

title.description: The beat's claim, or the id of a slide no beat names.

start.description: Where it starts, ms into the video.

end.description: Where it ends, ms: where the next starts, or the video ends.

Running.description: How far an export that is still going has got (SPEC §7.2).

done.description: `done` of `of`, counting `unit`: frames, pages, images, or beats.

elapsed_ms.description: How long it has run, ms.

spine.description:
The spine projection, for `spine` when it is not written (SPEC §10;
`docs/schema/spine.schema.json`).

pages.description: The state each page draws, in order: a PDF's pages, or the images of png and svg.

files.description:
The files written for png and svg, in the order of `pages`; for the spine, each
beat's renders.

size.description:
Pixels, width and height: of each image, of the video, or of the spine's
thumbnails.

duration_ms.description: How long a video runs, ms: its frames at its rate.

timeline.description: When each state plays in a video, in order.

chapters.description: A video's chapters: the spine's beats as it plays them, each titled by its claim.

bytes.description: The bytes written: the document, the video, or every image together.

running.description:
An export the MCP server is still running when it stops waiting for it, and how
far it has got (SPEC §7.2). Nothing else is said until it is done.
